items.title: Parkour.
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Four parts: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Gamer level parkour parts. You're on the clock! Tick-tock!

items.title: Scary Monsters
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Are you ready to frighten your friends dressed as a scary monster? Rule the streets on Halloween and be the creepiest monster ever seen. Sounds spooky enough? Get ready and dress up for the darkness!

+ 10 spooky skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Scary
+ Monsters

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Royal Demons
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Get ready to show your scary horns in this regal palace! All demons live in a big monarchical castle and can't wait for you to come to visit them. Try fun activities such as golf or tennis in this luxurious environment and live the life of the wealthiest demons in the kingdom! 

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Party  Enthusiasts
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Be the party ruler of today! Bring all of your friends to celebrate this incredible night; it's a common tradition to honor everyone's achievements. Reign from the top of your throne and be the spirit of the faction. Know your worth, and don't let anyone bring you down!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 crazy skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: ONE BLOCK 100 Days
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Take on the One Block challenge with a twist of 100 Days! Try to complete the one block skyblock challenge within 100 days!

Includes:
- One Block Skyblock
- Unique islands
- Hidden treasure
- Multiplayer and single-player
- And much more!

By KA Studios

items.title: Millionaire Row
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Pick your house on millionaires row, multiple cars to choose from! Be the talk of the neighbourhood with the best car, survive in the best neighbourhood.

items.title: World in a Bottle
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Begin your survival world inside of a bottle! With minimal starter tools, see how far you can expand your world.

- Spawn with a chest infront of you, filled with basic starter tools.
- The bottle is escapable; allowing for expansion.

items.title: Trendy Groove
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Get ready! New trends are here, and everyone is excited! Put on the latest trendy clothes and party with your friends. When done partying, come and binge-watch anime or play video games with your friends. Choose the skin that fits your summer fantasy the best. Join their team and have a fun time among the teens!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 11 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: ONE BLOCK Classic
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
ONE BLOCK!

- Break one block & get random drops! A new skyblock experience!

items.title: Magical Garden
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Indulge in the simpler things in life with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Stories tell of a mystical garden lying far over the horizon line. A place where mushroom grow as large as houses and the twin world trees tower overhead. Where birds and foxes the size of monsters live. Where YOU can now live!

items.title: Cyberpunk
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Welcome to FERC City, exclusively owned and operated by FERC Co. or Futuristic Excellence Realized Company Corporation if you want to be technical. Here, you can realize your full potential, as long as you follow all of our not at all unreasonable rules and and have very low expectations. Remember, we own everything!

items.title: Masked Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Masked teens are wandering around the city. Mocking and pranking everyone. Choose your own unique appearance and join the game as a master trickster.

+ Teen fashion
+ Masks
+ Anime style
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Pop It Buddies
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Pop it buddies are wonderful, squeeze skins made to add some more relax for your game experience. Choose your best color match and dive into the game with relaxing aesthetics.

+ Trendy
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Zombie Apocalypse
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
This skin pack is a perfect fit for zombie survival roleplay. It has a lot of different survivors skins. Gather up with friends and enjoy your own zombie survival story.

+ Zombie
+ Apocalypse
+ 2 free skins
+ By In Mine

items.title: Power Suits
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Check out these brand new power suits! Make it clear to everyone that you're well equipped, and ready to handle anything!

- 8 skins
- Pick the perfect armor for you!

items.title: Horned Teens
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
With their pointy horns, and brand new outfits, these teens are ready to cause some trouble!

- 8 demon skins!
- From fancy suits to cool hoodies, you can pick the perfect skin for you!

items.title: Summer Vacation
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Don't you love going on holiday? Wear a flashy colorful outfit and celebrate the season of summer! 

+ 10 stylish skins
+ Perfect for roleplaying
+ Show your friends your love of fashion 

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: High School Blue Sharks!
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description: Ready to get your game on? Join the football team at high school Blue Sharks and live out your best teen school life! These anime style HD skins come in a range of outfits, from preppy cheerleaders, to cute school uniforms! Play as one of these all star athletes, or the fintastic mascot, the blue shark! You decide with this epic new skin pack!

items.title: High School Red Lions!
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description: Ready to get your game on? Join the football team at high school Red Lions and live out your best teen school life! These anime style HD skins come in a range of outfits, from preppy cheerleaders, to cute school uniforms! Play as one of these all star athletes, or the roarsome mascot, the red lion! You decide with this epic new skin pack!

items.title: One Block Chunk Challenge
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to take up the One Block challenge?
Explore the different biomes and use the limited resources this world can provide you. 
Will you be able to defeat the Ender Dragon?

+80 different chunks!
+Limited resources!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: One Block Sky Grid
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description: Are you ready for a new skyblock experience? Mine the One Block to get random blocks or items, build your way through the grid, equip yourself and prepare for the battle with the Ender Dragon!

items.title: Punk Gamer Mobs
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Punk Gamer Mobs are here to take over the gaming world! Become an ally or compete against the mobs, the choice is yours!

- 20 epic skins
- 1 free skin
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Sweet House
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Get ready to live together with your friends in this sweet cottage with various types of cute custom furniture models. Let's bring sweetness and brightness all over the place.

- 38 unique furniture
- Survival base camp
- Licensed by Overtales Studio and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Royal Suits
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
This pack will win your hearts and make you feel like royalty! Inspired by playing cards, you can become a noble king, queen, or jack! Which suits you best?

+ 12 unique outfits for you to choose from!
